'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Thomas Schumann DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Schumann]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
